_about: Let's Be Besties Artist Collective, went live Nov 9 2026 1:41-4:25pm ET (launch watch Nov 9 5:57pm ET). Every listing is a full-size mat (31.5/33.5in neoprene + 33in leatherette). twinOf = same design as another listing in this drop (with Instructions / Simple Middle / duplicate listing): add as a second link, not a new card. holiday = holiday tag. images[0] = flat render.
